Guard! What's going on? Guard!''"
"''Keep quiet.|Barriss Offee talking with the shock trooper|}} A [[Cloning|clone]] [[shock trooper]] was created on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] and served in the [[Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[19 BBY]], shortly after the [[Order 66|end]] of the Clone Wars and the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge|Jedi Purge]], the trooper was stationed at the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]]. The former [[Jedi]] [[Barriss Offee]], who was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] in the Republic Center for Military Operations, saw the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] burning through the window of her cell. Frightened and curious about what had happened, she called the [[Imperial shock trooper|shock trooper]] guarding her cell to inquire about the situation. Responding to her calls, the shock trooper and their fellow guard approached Offee's cell, ignoring her question and telling her to keep quiet. When she asked if there had been an attack on the Jedi Temple, the clone told her to be glad that she was not a Jedi anymore and that the Order would not exist the following [[Standard day|day]]. Sometime afterwards, the shock trooper returned to Offee's cell with the former Jedi [[Fourth Sister|Lyn Rakish]]. Rakish had come to Offee's cell to offer her the chance to be freed and serve the new [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[Inquisitor]]. Though initially hesitant, Offee agreed upon noticing one of the troopers ready their [[blaster]], implying to Offee that she would be [[Death|killed]] should she refuse. ==Personality and traits== As a clone of [[Jango Fett]], the shock trooper stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall. The clone was authoritative, telling Offee to be quiet when she asked about the attack on the Jedi Temple. The [[soldier]] was confident that the Jedi Order would be wiped out overnight and slyly suggested that Offee be glad that she was no longer a part of it. The trooper was ready to kill Offee if she refused to travel to [[Nur]] and become an Inquisitor. ==Equipment== The clone shock trooper wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], painted with the red markings of the [[Coruscant Guard]].
